moodys.citation_text: Moody's indexed press release titled 'Moody's upgrades MetroHealth System (OH) to Baa2 from Baa3; stable outlook'. The exact date of that upgrade press release is not surfaced from the snippet but the title implies the upgrade was to Baa2/Stable. The October 30 2025 downgrade language ('downgraded to Baa3 from Baa2') confirms Baa2 was in effect immediately before that 2025 action and most likely throughout the 2022-12-31 to 2025-03-31 window.

sp.citation_text: MetroHealth is rated by Moody's only per universe v2; no S&P rating surfaced.

fitch.citation_text: MetroHealth is rated by Moody's only per universe v2; no Fitch rating surfaced.

moodys.citation_text: Becker's reporting on the October 30, 2025 downgrade frames it as 'downgraded to Baa3 from Baa2' implying Baa2 was the prior rating in effect through 2025-03-31. The negative outlook and Baa3 downgrade came October 30, 2025, AFTER window end.

outcome_class_rationale: No rating actions during the window 2022-12-31 to 2025-03-31. The October 30, 2025 Moody's downgrade (Baa2 -> Baa3, negative outlook) cited as a key universe v2 signal occurred AFTER window end. CEO turnover trigger and operating decline (EBIDA $104M, $37M below budget, $33M lower YoY in 2024) developed during the window but did not result in a rating action until 7 months after the window closed. Therefore: AFFIRM_STABLE within the strict window, with strong signal of impending downgrade by snapshot date 2025-03-31.

new_actions.rationale: Slower-than-expected pace of operating improvement leading to decline in liquidity. Strong patient demand and Medicaid supplemental funding partially offsetting; high governmental payer exposure (66% gross revenue) amid federal Medicaid cuts and labor competition.
